title: Learning to Select Source-Traceable Evidence for Language-Model Prediction from Irregular Clinical Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2605.20292v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Numerical time-series models effectively process irregular electronic health record (EHR) trajectories, but do not expose which temporal patterns support each prediction as readable evidence. Existing text-based interfaces either serialize observations, preserving source traceability but offering limited clinical interpretation, or generate patient-level summaries that improve readability but can obscure links to source measurements. We introduce STEP-CTS (Source-Traceable Evidence for Prediction from Clinical Time-Series), which learns to select source-traceable text evidence for a language-model predictor. Multi-scale window statistics of each trajectory are verbalized as sets of deterministic threshold predicates, each set linked to its source window (e.g., "[5-7 h]: last temperature at least 38C"). An offline LLM, run once per unique predicate set without access to patient records, the prediction task, or outcome labels, attaches

translated_title: 从不规则临床时间序列中学习选择可溯源证据以支持语言模型预测
translated_abstract: 数值时间序列模型能够有效处理不规则的电子健康记录（EHR）轨迹，但无法将支持每个预测的时间模式以可读证据的形式展现出来。现有的基于文本的接口要么将观测值序列化，虽保留了来源可追溯性，但临床解释能力有限；要么生成患者层面的摘要，虽提高了可读性，却可能模糊与原始测量数据之间的联系。我们提出STEP-CTS（面向临床时间序列预测的可溯源证据），它学习为语言模型预测器选择可溯源的文本证据。每条轨迹的多尺度窗口统计量被表述为确定性的阈值谓词集合，每个集合与其来源窗口相关联（例如，“[5-7小时]：最近一次体温至少38°C"）。一个离线大语言模型对每个唯一的谓词集合仅运行一次，且不接触患者记录、预测任务或结局标签，为…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: STEP-CTS将不规则临床时间序列转化为与其来源窗口绑定的确定性阈值谓词文本，使语言模型的预测能够附带可读且可溯源的证据依据。
en_tdlr: STEP-CTS verbalizes irregular clinical time series as deterministic threshold predicates linked to their source windows, enabling language-model predictions backed by readable and source-traceable evidence.
